name: Sudan civil war and US visa leverage

primer.text: Sudan's civil war is fought between SAF and RSF, rival armed forces each seeking control on the ground. The conflict has produced a humanitarian front centered on areas like Kordofan, where civilian sites such as a university dormitory, contested towns like al-Mazroub, and aid routes used by WFP trucks are at risk. That front is why outside leverage matters. The United States can use visas needed to attend the UN General Assembly (UNGA) as pressure to push the warring parties toward a ceasefire. In this context, UNGA is the United Nations General Assembly, the gathering of countries at the United Nations, and WFP is the humanitarian group that moves food aid.

current.bottom_line: Kordofan became the focal point of Sudan's war in the last three days, with a confirmed RSF drone strike on civilian student housing in El Obeid killing five and wounding 47, a reported deadly strike on a WFP aid truck in South Kordofan, and a reported SAF recapture of al-Mazroub. The UK on Oct 2 publicly blamed external weapons flows for sustaining the conflict. No new US visa-leverage actions appeared in the evidence window.

timeline.headline: WFP reports airstrike on UN aid truck in South Kordofan kills driver
timeline.detail: On 2026-10-04 the World Food Programme reported an airstrike on a UN truck in South Kordofan state that killed the driver, per a single outlet report.

timeline.headline: UK at UN blames external arms flows for sustaining Sudan war
timeline.detail: On 2026-10-02 the UK Permanent Representative to the UN said the illegal flow of weapons and external support is sustaining the conflict in Sudan and demanded all states stop supporting the warring parties, respect international humanitarian law and use influence to protect civilians and secure humanitarian access.

timeline.headline: SAF says it recaptured North Kordofan town of al-Mazroub
timeline.detail: On 2026-10-02 Sudan's armed forces announced they had recaptured the North Kordofan town of al-Mazroub, described as an RSF stronghold, per a single outlet report.

timeline.headline: RSF drone strike hits University of Kordofan dormitory in El Obeid, killing 5 confirmed
timeline.detail: On 2026-10-01 a drone strike hit student housing belonging to the University of Kordofan in El Obeid, North Kordofan, killing five civilians and wounding 47, per confirmed research. The strike was attributed to the RSF in multiple outlet reports. One outlet later reported the death toll had risen to 10, single source, not confirmed by our research.
